reviews.text: I placed my order a month ago and still haven't received it. Furthermore, the website's customer area isn't working properly. The company's response to my review is untrue.

10 out of 10! I had a problem with my order and they were very professional, resolving it incredibly quickly. The collar and leash are beautiful and of excellent quality. I will definitely buy from this store again; I highly recommend them. Thank you so much!

I placed an order on August 6th, and I'm still waiting for it to arrive. When I finally manage to contact them, they tell me they're on vacation and not shipping. Okay, fine, since it was in small print, I didn't see it. They don't offer the 10% discount for new customers during sales, so I guess I'll just have to accept that.

Today, I've been asking since 3 PM when my order will arrive or if they'll give me the tracking number (I have to download an app that I can't and don't care to download). They supposedly shipped it on Monday, but today is Thursday, and I can't see the tracking information, and they're not answering my WhatsApp messages. This is the first and last time I buy from them. Everyone has the right to take vacations, but customer service when you return from vacation is essential, especially when I see they're checking WhatsApp and reading some of my messages.

I have to say the product is great.
And a really positive comment is that I had a problem and they resolved it very well because sometimes when you make a complaint they don't help you, but in this case they were super friendly.

I bought a Martingale collar with its matching leash from this brand and I couldn't be happier. The materials and workmanship are excellent. Also, before buying, I had some doubts about the width of the collar (the one he's wearing is 4 cm) and they answered them very quickly, which gave me a lot of confidence.

I was worried that the buckles would be too big for my dog, since he's an Italian Greyhound and very small, but he finds it very comfortable. With other collars, he would constantly scratch himself because he has very little fur and his skin is quite sensitive, but with this one, so far, I haven't seen him scratch even once.

I will definitely buy from them again. 😁😁

I just received it. It's ideal and the size is perfect for Nala. Thank you so much.
The only thing is that the delivery was slightly delayed, but Bimba's brand was always responsive and helpful. The wait was worth it.

I bought the "England Dog Harness" vest last week and received it today.
The quality is excellent, and I really like the design.
I'm a little worried that the metal buckles on the neck and chest might be a bit heavy for my dog.
Otherwise, I'm very satisfied.
I think the quality is even better because it's custom-made.
I'll have to use it a few times to see how functional it is, but if my dog ​​isn't uncomfortable in it, I plan to buy another one. 😀👍

My favorite brand for dog beds and harnesses.
I have a Maltese and I've had them for two years now, and I'm thrilled with them. It's my go-to brand. They make everything in their workshop in Valencia using high-quality materials.

Hi! I own Dua, a female Kaninchen Dachshund. This is the second time I've bought from this lovely Spanish brand. I'm delighted with their products, especially the craftsmanship and elegance of their harnesses, as well as their durability. Excellent quality and design. And I can't forget the great customer service! I definitely recommend them 100%! The photos show two of their harness models—they're gorgeous!

I've placed three orders and we're thrilled, especially our dog.
The beds, besides being beautiful, are very comfortable, and our furry friend loves them.
Plus, the orders arrived quickly, and communication with them was excellent. Without a doubt, if I need anything else, I'll order from Be de Bimba again!

Since I got my dog ​​(over 4 years ago), I've only bought from Bedebimba.
The beds last ages and he loves them. When you ask for a specific detail on the harness, they do it without hesitation. They have tons of products, all of excellent quality, and the women who run the store are fantastic!

I've already bought two beds for my dog ​​and I'm delighted. We really appreciate that they're handmade and personalized, and the quality is excellent. Plus, they provide great customer service, answering questions through social media.

Incredible craftsmanship. We bought a baby bed and a harness with a leash, and from the moment you touch the material, you can feel the quality of the fabric, as well as the attention to detail in every stitch. You won't find anything like …
Great! Quality products with unique designs at a good price. They even included a little cookie with our order. Fast shipping.
